thread:
incident-bot: Pager — NOVAEDGE (prod-private) auth failures: elevated 401s to tenant gateway. Alert rule: vpc-auth-5xx-or-401s. Link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/1968174321

lisa (on-call): acked — looking. paging oncall now. @alice you'll want to watch the auth-proxy logs.

alice (SRE): on it. initial look: lots of ``invalid_signature`` and ``kid not found`` from token validation. hitting our private tenant JWKS fetch flow. examples:
```
2026-03-15T12:03:11Z auth-proxy[pod-7f9d] ERROR verify_token: invalid_signature kid="a3f2..."
2026-03-15T12:04:09Z auth-proxy[pod-7f9d] WARN fetch_jwks: fetched jwks (len=3) for issuer https://id.novaedge.corp/.well-known/jwks.json
2026-03-15T12:04:10Z auth-proxy[pod-7f9d] ERROR verify_token: kid not found in local jwks
```

ben (Platform): NovaEdge told us they rotated keys ~12:01 UTC and pushed new JWKS to their IdP. Our cache TTL is 5m and we have a race where some pods still have old cached JWKS. Also seeing a failed background refresh due to 502 from idp at 12:02.

carla (CS): NovaEdge reporting 95% of auth attempts failing between 12:02-12:14 UTC, impacted all private tenant calls; customer escalated to SE team. Customer wants ETA and mitigation.

matt (infra): quick mitigation: rolling restart auth-proxy pods to force JWKS refresh. Will do canary (1/5) now and monitor.

alice (SRE): please run:
```
kubectl -n novaedge rollout restart deployment/auth-proxy --selector=tenant=novaedge --record
kubectl -n novaedge exec -it pod/auth-proxy-7f9d -- curl -sS https://id.novaedge.corp/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys | length'
```

deploy-bot: Started rolling restart of deployment/auth-proxy (5 pods) at 12:06 UTC

lisa (on-call): canary pod restarted, auth checks green on canary — 200s for token verification now. proceeding with rest of rolling restart.

alice (SRE): after restart, auth-proxy logs show new jwks keys present and no ``kid not found``. customer report inbound: decreasing 401 rate. sample after fix:
```
2026-03-15T12:10:34Z auth-proxy[auth-proxy-1] INFO verify_token: success kid="b9c4..."
```

carla (CS): novaedge confirms traffic normalizing, still seeing some errors from older clients with cached tokens. They will flush client caches and re-issue tokens.

ben (Platform): root cause: IdP rotated keys and returned a JWKS with new kid order; our ephemeral JWKS cache + occasional 502 on IdP refresh caused a window where some pods didn't pick up the new key. Secondary factor: our JWKS fetcher fails open incorrectly on 502 (logs show ``fetch_jwks failed, keeping old set``) — that behavior prolonged the mismatch.

alice (SRE): mitigation checklist:
- Rolling restart auth-proxy (completed)
- Shorten JWKS cache TTL from 300s -> 60s for tenant flows (hotfixed)
- Add fallback to previous JWKS + aggressive immediate refetch on 4xx/5xx response
- Postmortem and customer RCA draft

lisa (on-call): done. I've added an incident label and paged oncall-next for follow-up. @ben will own platform fix; @alice will own immediate RCA. @carla to keep customer updated.

carla (CS): shared initial customer impact summary to NovaEdge: "We observed elevated auth failures 12:02–12:14 UTC affecting ~95% of requests to tenant gateway. Root cause: JWKS rotation race between NovaEdge IdP and our auth-proxy cache. We applied a rolling restart and reduced JWKS TTL; requests are now returning to normal. Next steps: postmortem with timeline and code changes."

matt (infra): cameras: added emergency monitor: alert if tenant jwks-fetch errors > 5/min for 10m. Also creating a canary test that validates a fresh token after JWKS rotation in our CI.

lisa (on-call): handing off to @alice for long-running actions. I'll remain on the thread until they confirm RCA doc. oncall-next: @raj you may need to own extra rollout if the hotfix causes regressions.

alice (SRE): noted. creating postmortem/incident doc and will estimate severity/SEV. Proposed severity: SEV2 (partial outage for single enterprise customer). Timeline & drafts by EOD.

incident-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-1968174321-novaedge-auth. Auto-generated runbook: https://ops.redwood/incidents/1968174321

carla (CS): NovaEdge thanks the team for quick action. SEEM: they'll wait for formal RCA and ask for a follow-up call this afternoon.

lisa (on-call): closing page. If anything reappears please re-page. :thumbsup:
